item.title: [News] Echoverse: Deep, evolving environments for computer-use agents
item.description: Microsoft Research has announced Echoverse, a platform that trains AI agents in realistic environments with evolving tasks and tests. This aims to improve AI agents' ability to handle multi-step workflows like email and customer support.

item.title: [News] EvoLib: Turning experience into evolving knowledge
item.description: Microsoft Research has announced EvoLib, a system that turns experience into evolving knowledge, helping LLMs learn and adapt across tasks without needing more data.

item.title: [News] Science One Framework: A verifiable autonomous research framework via Chain-of-Evidence
item.description: Google AI has released a verifiable autonomous research framework via Chain-of-Evidence, called Science One Framework. This framework helps increase trust in AI research and decision-making, but its specific impact on IT infrastructure is unclear.

item.title: [News] GPU Management: Why Idle GPUs Are the New Grounded Aircraft
item.description: Hugging Face discusses the need for efficient GPU management, highlighting idle GPUs that equate to grounded aircraft. Efficient GPU usage reduces costs and accelerates training times.

item.title: [News] Gemini Robotics ER 2: powering robotics with video understanding, task orchestration, and multi-robot collaboration
item.description: Google DeepMind has released Gemini Robotics ER 2, a system that improves video understanding, task orchestration, and multi-robot collaboration. This marks a step change in robotics capabilities for real-world tasks.
